title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يحاضر في السودان عن مناقب آل البيت وواجب الامة تجاهم
title_en: The Sheikh Lectures in Sudan on the Merits of the Prophetic Household and the Community's Duty towards Them
body_ar: يشارك فضيلة الشيخ محمـد الحسن الددو ـ حفظه الله تعالى في " مؤتمر آل البيت النبوي الشريف مناقبهم و علاقة الصحابة الابرار بهم وواجب الأمة تجاهم " المنعقد بقاعة المؤتمرات ـ جامعة إفريقيا العالمية بدولة السودان يومي 18 – 19 فبراير 2015 م. وقد ألقى فضيلته يوم أمس 18 فبراير كلمة بعنوان : عناية العلماء ببيان مكانة الصحابة و آل البيت تحدث فيها عن مناقب آل البيت ووجوب احترام الصحابة و الاقتداء بهم . كما تحدث فضيلته عن عناية علماء الأمة بأحكام الآل والأصحاب بداية بالتعريف حيث تطلق عبارة الآل فتشمل الصحابة في مقام الصلاة فيكفي ذكر عبارة الآل عن ذكر الأصحاب مرورا بأحكام يختصون بها عن باقي الصحابة كحرمة الصدقة عليهم واستحقاقهم لخمس الخمس من الغنائم وهدي السلف في توقيرهم وغيرها من الأحكام والآداب معهم رضي الله عنهم أجمعين . كما احتضن المسجد العتيق بجامعة إفريقيا العالمية ظهر اليوم 19 فبراير 2015 م محاضرة لفضيلة الشيخ بعنوان : " طلب العلم الشرعي فضله ومنهجيته "
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew (may God the Exalted preserve him) is taking part in the 'Conference on the Noble Prophetic Household: Their Merits, the Relationship of the Righteous Companions with Them, and the Community's Duty towards Them', held in the conference hall of the International University of Africa in Sudan on 18 and 19 February 2015.

Yesterday, 18 February, His Eminence delivered an address entitled 'The Scholars' Attention to Setting Out the Standing of the Companions and of the Prophetic Household', in which he spoke of the merits of the Household and of the obligation to respect the Companions and to follow their example.

His Eminence also spoke of the attention the community's scholars have given to the rulings concerning the Household and the Companions — beginning with the definition, where the expression 'the Household' is used so as to take in the Companions in the setting of the prayer upon the Prophet, so that mentioning 'the Household' suffices in place of mentioning 'the Companions'; passing on to rulings particular to them as distinct from the rest of the Companions, such as the prohibition of voluntary charity (ṣadaqah) being given to them and their entitlement to a fifth of the fifth of the spoils; and the practice of the early generations in honouring them, and other rulings and proprieties in dealing with them, may God be pleased with them all.

The Old Mosque at the International University of Africa also hosted, at midday today, 19 February 2015, a lecture by His Eminence entitled 'Seeking Religious Knowledge: Its Merit and Its Method'.

flags.arabic: تطلق عبارة الآل فتشمل الصحابة في مقام الصلاة فيكفي ذكر عبارة الآل عن ذكر الأصحاب
flags.context: the point of definition reported from the address
options: 'the Household' is used so as to take in the Companions in the setting of the prayer upon the Prophet, so that mentioning it suffices in place of mentioning the Companions
in the formula of prayer upon the Prophet the word 'Household' extends to the Companions as well
flags.note: The claim is a technical one about the extension of الآل in the ṣalāh ʿalā al-nabī formula, and it is the report's own compression of what the Sheikh said. It is a position with sectarian weight, and the record gives no argument for it. Rendered as literally as English allows, without clarifying what the Arabic leaves compressed.

flags.arabic: مناقب آل البيت … ووجوب احترام الصحابة
flags.context: the subject of the conference and of the address
flags.note: EDITORIAL, LOW. The relationship between the Prophet's Household and the Companions is the central dividing question between Sunni and Shia Islam, and a conference and address on it are taking a position by their framing, before any content. The record reports the Sunni framing without polemic and without naming any other position. Translated faithfully and neither softened nor sharpened; noted because an English reader meets it without the setting a Khartoum audience has.

flags.context: the rulings particular to the Household
options: a fifth of the fifth of the spoils
one fifth of the war booty's fifth share
flags.note: The reference is to the portion assigned in Sūrat al-Anfāl 8:41 to the Prophet's near relatives, out of the fifth set aside from the spoils. The verse is not cited in the record and has not been supplied.

translator_notes: A news report of two addresses, not their text. The second lecture, on seeking knowledge, is announced and not reported at all.
آل البيت is rendered 'the Prophetic Household' on first use and 'the Household' thereafter; the Arabic alternates between آل البيت and الآل in the same way.
The source has الابرار without its hamza; preserved in body_ar.
